title: Market price
description: What the book is paying for the home side right now, in cents on the dollar. The away side is always one dollar minus home.

home.label: Home
home.description: The market's current odds that the home team wins, as a price in cents. Fifty cents is a coin flip.

away.label: Away
away.description: The market's current odds that the away team wins, as a price in cents. Always one dollar minus the home price.

bid.label: Best bid
bid.description: The highest price someone is waiting to pay for the home side. Selling home right now fills here.

ask.label: Best ask
ask.description: The lowest price someone is waiting to sell the home side at. Buying home right now fills here.

last.label: Last trade
last.description: The price of the most recent fill in this round. It lags the book when nobody is trading.
